主往复轴的逻辑目标值。0 表示最缩回，999 表示最伸出。输出层仍会继续套用轴配: Main stroke target: 0 is fully retracted, 999 fully extended. Output axis constraints still apply.
前后平移轴的逻辑目标值；按 TCode 约定，较小值朝前、较大值朝后，500 附: Forward/back target: lower values move forward, higher values backward; about 500 is centered. Output constraints still apply.
左右平移轴的逻辑目标值；按 TCode 约定，正向为用户左侧；500 附近表示居: Lateral target: positive is toward the user's left; about 500 is centered.
绕 L0 轴旋转的扭转逻辑值；500 附近表示居中。: Rotation around L0; about 500 is centered.
绕 L1 轴旋转的滚转逻辑值；500 附近表示居中。: Rotation around L1; about 500 is centered.
绕 L2 轴旋转的俯仰逻辑值；500 附近表示居中。: Rotation around L2; about 500 is centered.
主震动逻辑值。0 为关闭，999 为最大；输出层仍会继续套用轴配置约束。: Primary vibration: 0 is off, 999 maximum. Output constraints still apply.
第二路震动逻辑值。0 为关闭，999 为最大。: Second vibration channel: 0 is off, 999 maximum.
第三路震动逻辑值。0 为关闭，999 为最大。: Third vibration channel: 0 is off, 999 maximum.
辅助通道 1 的逻辑值；500 附近表示居中。: Auxiliary channel 1 target; about 500 is centered.
辅助通道 2 的逻辑值；500 附近表示居中。: Auxiliary channel 2 target; about 500 is centered.
辅助通道 3 的逻辑值；500 附近表示居中。: Auxiliary channel 3 target; about 500 is centered.
当前会优先采用校准后更深（归一化更高）的一条映射结果: The deeper calibrated result (higher normalized value) takes priority
把点击位置写成 A 点: Set A at the clicked time
把点击位置写成 B 点: Set B at the clicked time
拖拽选择 A-B 时，可随时放弃当前框选: Cancel the current A–B drag selection at any time
支持 `.funscript` / `.json`；导入完成后这里会变成可编辑的: Supports `.funscript` / `.json`. After import, this becomes an editable timeline.
循环开关与时间倍率可以先设置好，当前浏览器会自动记住。: Set looping and playback speed in advance; this browser remembers them.
时间轴拖拽、A-B 框选、关键帧步进和快捷键会在载入后直接可用。: Timeline dragging, A–B selection, keyframe stepping and shortcuts become available after loading.
最常用的传输控制与关键帧步进。: Common playback controls and keyframe stepping.
在当前时间点继续播放或暂停脚本: Resume or pause at the current time
跳到上一个关键帧，适合逐帧对点: Step to the previous keyframe for precise inspection
跳到下一个关键帧，快速检查节奏: Step to the next keyframe to inspect timing
短距离、长距离和整段跳转拆开显示，不再混成一行。: Short, long and full-length jumps are grouped separately.
以当前播放位置为基准向前回退 5 秒: Seek backward 5 seconds from the playhead
以当前播放位置为基准向后前进 5 秒: Seek forward 5 seconds from the playhead
直接把时间轴拉回脚本起点: Seek to the beginning of the script
直接定位到脚本结尾: Seek to the end of the script
把“设置标记”和“跳到标记”拆开，减少记忆负担。: Setting markers and jumping to markers are separate controls.
把当前位置写成循环起点 A: Set the current time as loop start A
把当前位置写成循环终点 B: Set the current time as loop end B
快速回到当前已设置的 A 点: Seek to the existing A marker
快速跳到当前已设置的 B 点: Seek to the existing B marker
这里只改时间倍率，不改 TCode 的 S 速度。: Changes timeline speed, not TCode S speed.
OSR 首次测试 · L0 小行程: OSR first test · small L0 stroke
只输出 L0，逻辑 0–100% 映射为 TCode 400–600，速度上限: L0 only: logical 0–100% maps to TCode 400–600, speed limit 100; all other axes ignored. Verify the hardware center and allowed range. This is not hardware calibration; saving does not enable motion.
保留 L0 / L1 / L2 / R0 / R1 / R2 六个主运动轴，默认: Keeps L0 / L1 / L2 / R0 / R1 / R2; ignores V0 / V1 / V2 and A0 / A1 / A2 by default.
仅保留 L0 / R1 / R2（主轴 + 滚转 + 俯仰），忽略 L1 / L: Keeps L0 / R1 / R2 (stroke, roll, pitch); ignores L1 / L2 / R0, V0 / V1 / V2 and A0 / A1 / A2.
只让 L0 主往复轴参与控制；L1 / L2 / R0 / R1 / R2、V0: Only L0 participates; ignores L1 / L2 / R0 / R1 / R2, V0 / V1 / V2 and A0 / A1 / A2.
保留 L0，姿态轴与 A0 / A1 / A2 锁定在中位，V0 / V1 /: Keeps L0; locks rotation and A0 / A1 / A2 at center, ignores V0 / V1 / V2. Useful when only stroke should move with a fixed pose.
UDP 地址 {0}:{1} 与另一条 Hub 目标重复。: UDP endpoint {0}:{1} duplicates another Hub target.
目标地址指向当前 Sensa OSC 监听端口，会形成回环。: The target points to Sensa's OSC listener and would create a loop.
斜率方式为“无”时，只发送位置值。下方速度限制会保留，但当前不会参与输出。: None sends positions only. The speed limit is retained but does not affect this output.
发送 I 指令；兼容性通常比 S 更好。下方速度限制仍然表示同一套速度上限，系统: Sends I commands, often more widely supported than S. The same speed limit is converted to an I duration using the current displacement.
发送 S 指令；直接按速度上限约束该轴。若设备对 S 支持不稳定，建议优先使用时: Sends S commands to limit this axis directly. Prefer Time (I) if the firmware does not reliably support S.
当前斜率方式为“无”，因此这个速度限制暂时不会参与输出；切回时间或速度后会继续沿: Motion mode is None, so this limit is currently inactive. It applies again when Time or Speed is selected.
无论发送 S 还是 I，这里限制的本质都是最大速度上限。选择 I 时，系统会按当: This is a maximum speed for both S and I. In I mode, displacement and this limit determine the duration.
实时连接未就绪，请稍后重试。: Live connection is not ready. Please retry shortly.
实时连接未建立，请稍后重试。: Live connection has not been established. Please retry shortly.
轴模式为“忽略”，不发送该轴指令: Axis is ignored; no command is sent
轴配置处理后目标未变化，跳过发送: Target unchanged after axis processing; send skipped
拖拽中：松开后会应用 A-B {0} → {1}；按 Esc 可取消。: Dragging: release to apply A–B {0} → {1}; Esc cancels.
已选起点 {0}，继续拖动可直接框选 A-B。: Start {0} selected; keep dragging to select A–B.
预览 {0}；点击定位，Shift + 点击设 A，Alt + 点击设 B。: Preview {0}; click to seek, Shift + click sets A, Alt + click sets B.
点击定位；Shift + 点击设 A，Alt + 点击设 B；拖拽可直接框选完整: Click to seek; Shift + click sets A, Alt + click sets B; drag to select A–B.
载入脚本后这里会显示时间轴摘要。: Load a script to see the timeline summary.
定位 {0}；Shift + 点击设 A，Alt + 点击设 B: Seek {0}; Shift + click sets A, Alt + click sets B
串口 TCode 输出连接后会按 D0 / D1 / D2 查询固件版本、TCo: Serial TCode outputs query firmware, TCode version and axis descriptions with D0 / D1 / D2 after connecting. Unsupported queries show “No response”.
该轴已忽略，不会参与输出。: This axis is ignored and will not drive output.
锁定模式下，这个轴会固定在指定位置；位置使用 0-999 的设备尺度表示。: Locked mode holds this axis at the specified position on the device's 0–999 scale.
先把逻辑值 0~1 缩放到这个设备位置区间，再交给边界做最终夹紧。和“边界”不同: Scales logical 0–1 into this device position range, then clamps to the limits. This actively remaps the output.
最终输出会被夹在这个位置区间内，适合做限位或保留安全余量；它不会把输入重新缩放到: Clamps the final target into this range for limits or extra margin. It does not rescale input into the range.
非标准扩展：在 S/I 指令后附加 = / < / > / <>。若设备不支持，: Nonstandard extension: appends = / < / > / <> to S/I commands. Leave None if unsupported by your device.
这个名称只用于在当前页面里区分不同 Hub 目标。: Only used to distinguish Hub targets in this UI.
关闭后会保留这条目标配置，但 Hub 不会向它发包。: Disabling keeps the configuration but stops Hub packets to this target.
Hub 转发的 UDP 目标地址。通常是 127.0.0.1 或目标程序所在设备: UDP destination for the Hub, usually 127.0.0.1 or the target application's LAN address.
Hub 转发的 UDP 目标端口。: UDP destination port for Hub forwarding.
支持精确匹配、*、**；多个候选路径用分号分隔。所有命中值参与融合，同轴选择校准: Supports exact paths, * and **; separate alternatives with semicolons. All matches participate; the stronger calibrated value wins on each axis. Preview shows the latest update.
选择这条 OSC 映射最终驱动的设备轴；同一目标轴的多条规则在重叠区当前不会叠加: Select the driven axis. Overlapping rules on the same axis do not add together: the deeper calibrated result wins. For L1, lower values mean forward and higher values backward.
交换输入最小值 / 输入最大值的方向，常用于深度方向相反或姿态方向相反的参数。: Reverses the input range direction, useful for reversed depth or orientation signals.
只在当前页面里做预览，不会发给后端，也不会写入配置。适合在没有真实 OSC 参数: Preview only in this page; nothing is sent to the backend or saved. Try input ranges, curves and remap ranges without live OSC data.
本地预览用的原始输入值。拖动它可以直接看到当前输入范围、曲线与映射范围会把这个值: Raw input for the local preview. Drag to see how input range, curve and remap range determine the device target.
把原始 OSC 值的某一段校准为逻辑 0~1。比如设成 0.25~0.75，就会: Calibrates a range of raw OSC values to logical 0–1. For example, 0.25–0.75 expands the middle half to the full logical range. Values outside are clamped to 0/1.
校准和曲线处理后的逻辑 0/1，会被放到这个设备位置区间；范围 0-999。比如: Places calibrated and curved logical 0/1 in this 0–999 device range. For example, use 200–800 to restrict the full input to that stroke range.
它改变的是输入值到逻辑目标值的分布，不直接改变最终发给设备的 S/I 形式。缓入: Changes the distribution of logical targets, not the S/I command form. Ease in offers finer control near the start, ease out near the end, ease in/out at both ends.
先设好速度和循环偏好，加载脚本后会自动沿用；这些偏好会记住到当前浏览器。: Set speed and looping before loading a script; this browser remembers these preferences.
已开启。当前存在完整 A-B 区间，播放时会只在 A-B 区间内循环。: Enabled: playback loops within the complete A–B range.
已开启。当前还没有完整 A-B 区间，播放时会按整段脚本循环。: Enabled: no complete A–B range, so playback loops over the entire script.
已关闭。当前会从当前位置播放到结尾一次。: Disabled: plays once from the current time to the end.
正在读取并导入脚本…导入完成后会自动同步到时间轴工作区。: Reading and importing script… The timeline will update when import finishes.
选择一个 .funscript / .json 文件后即可进入时间轴工作区，后续: Choose a .funscript / .json file to drag the timeline, set A–B and step through keyframes.
当前脚本模式固定按脚本内容直接发送位置。常规 funscript 只有位置关键帧: Script mode sends positions directly. Standard funscripts contain position keyframes only, so axis/output profiles do not automatically add S / I commands.
这里调整的是脚本时间倍率，不是 TCode S 速度；只影响脚本在时间轴上的推进: This changes timeline playback speed, not TCode S speed.
快捷键只在脚本页空白区域生效；输入框、按钮和滑条获得焦点时会自动让出键盘，长按按: Shortcuts work in the script page's blank area. Inputs, buttons and sliders retain keyboard focus; holding a key does not repeat commands.
载入脚本后可拖动定位: Load a script to drag and seek
脚本文件内容正在读取并同步到 Companion；导入完成后，这里会自动切换成完: Reading and syncing the script to Companion. The full timeline will appear when import finishes.
先选择一个脚本文件，随后就可以在这里拖动时间轴、框选 A-B、用快捷键对点和按关: Choose a script to drag the timeline, select A–B, use shortcuts and step through keyframes.
脚本已加载，输入已关闭；检查时间轴后再打开输入。: Script loaded; input is off. Check the timeline before enabling input.
已切换到 {0}，输入已关闭；检查目标后再打开输入。: Switched to {0}; input is off. Check the target before enabling input.
已用此对象替换整套映射草稿，旧门控已移除；固定来源后保存，保存后需重新打开输入。: Replaced the entire draft with this object and removed old gates. Pin the source, save, then re-enable input.
这是根部阵列诊断样本，不能直接映射行程。请查看单侧 SPS 根部定位面板。: This is a root-array diagnostic sample, not a stroke signal. See the one-sided SPS root panel.
已添加 Root/Tip 配对草稿，请检查后保存。: Root/Tip draft added. Review before saving.
已添加映射草稿，请确认参数含义、目标轴和范围后保存。: Mapping draft added. Check its meaning, target axis and range before saving.
已用校准结果替换整套映射草稿，旧门控已移除；确认来源后保存，再手动打开输入。: Calibration replaced the entire draft and removed old gates. Confirm the source, save, then manually enable input.
已用本地 Z 位移替换整套草稿，旧门控已移除；请先校准量程再保存。: Local Z displacement replaced the entire draft and removed old gates. Calibrate the range before saving.
已在当前页面清空映射；如需放弃更改，可点“恢复映射”: Cleared this page's mappings. Use “Restore mappings” to discard this change.
OSC 映射已保存并应用，输入已关闭；检查接收值后再打开输入。: OSC mappings saved and applied; input is off. Check received values before enabling input.
已在当前页面追加预设：{0}；保存后才会真正应用: Appended preset to this page: {0}. Save to apply.
已在当前页面应用预设：{0}；保存后才会真正应用: Applied preset to this page: {0}. Save to apply.
内置预设不能删除；如需修改，请复制为自定义预设。: Built-in presets cannot be deleted. Copy one to customize it.
设置默认轴配置失败: Failed to set default axis profile
默认轴配置不能移除: The default axis profile cannot be removed
{0} 已移除，相关输出已回退到默认轴配置: {0} removed; affected outputs now use the default profile
请输入有效时间码，例如 01:23.45、1:30 或 90: Enter a valid time, such as 01:23.45, 1:30 or 90
这套预设暂未提供说明。: No description provided for this preset.
选中预设后可在这里查看说明。: Select a preset to see its description.
当前没有可用预设，可先新建一套。: No presets available. Create one to begin.
脚本正在导入，完成后会自动切入时间轴。: Importing the script. The timeline will open when ready.
正在播放，可随时定位、步进或调整 A-B。: Playing. Seek, step or adjust A–B at any time.
已暂停，可继续对点或调整 A-B。: Paused. Inspect keyframes or adjust A–B.
已到结尾，可重播或重新设定区间。: Reached the end. Replay or adjust the range.
已载入，可直接定位、步进或调整 A-B。: Loaded. Seek, step or adjust A–B.
选择一个 .funscript / .json 文件后，就可以像播放器一样直接拖: Choose a .funscript / .json file to drag the timeline, select A–B and step through keyframes.
载入后可在这里查看 A / B 状态、跳到边界或清除区间。: After loading, inspect A/B, jump to boundaries or clear the range here.
当前区间长度 {0}，约占全段 {1}%。: Range duration {0}, about {1}% of the script.
已设置单侧标记；补齐另一侧后就会形成完整 A-B 区间。: One marker is set; add the other to complete the A–B range.
载入脚本后这里会显示当前进度。: Progress appears here after loading a script.
载入后这里会显示当前取点基准。: Marker reference appears here after loading.
只改脚本推进节奏，不改硬件 S 速度。: Changes playback timing, not hardware S speed.
脚本模式会按位置关键帧直接输出；倍率只改时间推进，不代表硬件 S 速度。: Script mode sends position keyframes directly; speed changes timeline progression, not hardware S speed.
可先设置 A / B 标记: You can set A / B markers first
检测到多个来源，请先固定“使用来源”: Multiple sources detected. Pin “Active source” first.
当前还没有任何输出设备。添加并启用至少一个输出后，输入数据才会真正发送到硬件。: No output devices yet. Add and enable an output before input data can reach hardware.
当前所有输出都处于禁用状态。即使输入在变化，也不会真正发到任何设备；请先启用至少: All outputs are disabled. Changing input will not reach a device until an output is enabled.
手动模式固定使用 I 指令，滑条值表示到达目标位置所需时长（毫秒），当前上限为: Manual mode uses I commands. The slider sets time to reach the target in milliseconds, up to 1000 ms.
手动模式固定使用 S 指令；这里填写的是逻辑速度，真正发给设备的 S 数值会在每: Manual mode uses S commands. This logical speed is converted for each output using its axis limit and speed unit. Prefer Time (I) or Follow axis profile if S is unreliable.
跟随轴配置：每个轴按各自轴配置决定使用时间、速度或无。这里填写的是逻辑速度上限；: Follow axis profile: each axis uses Time, Speed or None. This logical speed limit converts to duration for I or to the output's final S value.
正在同步服务状态与设备配置…: Syncing service status and device settings…
第一次使用 OSR？先给 Avatar 添加 Quick Start World: New to OSR? Add Quick Start World Receiver to your avatar, check OSC in the test world, then connect hardware.
连接输出 → 设置输入 → 校准映射 → 启用输入: Connect output → Set input → Calibrate mappings → Enable input
当前输入开关已关闭。你现在切换输入页签、拖动手动滑条或等待 OSC/脚本更新，都: Input is off. Changing tabs, dragging manual sliders or receiving OSC/script updates will not drive outputs. Enable input before testing.
切页签只切界面；点“应用输入方式”后才会真正生效。: Tabs only change the view. Click “Apply input mode” to change the running input.
OSC 门控已关闭，输出已停止；所有门控信号开启后恢复。: OSC gate is closed; output stopped. It resumes when all gates open.
精确定位当前不可用或未进入孔口，输出已停止。请检查下方观测状态；多个来源时先固定: Precise tracking is unavailable or outside the opening; output stopped. Check observations below and pin the source if there are multiple sources.
这是 OSC 接收器本身的配置开关。关闭后会停止本地 UDP OSC 监听；它不: Controls the OSC receiver. Turning it off stops local UDP OSC listening, but does not change the input mode selected at the top.
默认仅本机；局域网监听请设置允许来源: Localhost by default; set allowed sources for LAN listening
OSC 可能仅在值变化时发送；仅在持续发送的来源上启用。: OSC may send only on change. Enable this only for continuously transmitting sources.
当前输入方式仍是 OSC，但 OSC 接收器已关闭，因此不会接收新的 OSC 数: OSC is still the active input mode, but the receiver is off. Enable OSC and save to receive new data.
启用后，Sensa 会连接远端 OSCQuery 服务并同步参数树；如果对端支持: Connects to a remote OSCQuery service and synchronizes its parameter tree; subscribes in real time if LISTEN is supported.
远端 OSCQuery 服务的根地址，例如 http://127.0.0.1:9: Remote OSCQuery root URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:9001/.
当对端不支持 LISTEN 时，按固定频率重新拉取可读节点的当前值。: Periodically fetches readable node values when the peer does not support LISTEN.
轮询回退的频率。只在启用轮询回退时生效。: Polling rate; used only when polling fallback is enabled.
把 Sensa 广播成 OSCQuery receiver，方便 VRChat: Advertises Sensa as an OSCQuery receiver so VRChat can discover it and send OSC to the listening port.
启用后，Sensa 会把当前实时 OSC 数据转发到下面配置的多个 UDP 目标: Forwards current live OSC data to the UDP targets below.
事件驱动表示参数一变化就立即转发；固定频率表示在每个周期里合并为最新值后再发送。: Event driven forwards every change immediately; fixed rate sends the latest merged values each interval.
仅固定频率模式生效；事件驱动模式下会忽略。: Used only in fixed-rate mode; ignored in event-driven mode.
请先在右侧参数预览里固定“使用来源”。: Pin “Active source” in the parameter preview first.
这里决定 Sensa 在多来源同时存在时，OSC 映射预览与实时驱动默认使用哪个: Selects the source for OSC mapping previews and live control when multiple sources exist. The tabs below only change what you browse.
★ 置顶参数会保留显示；冻结仅暂停表格，不停止设备。: ★ Pinned parameters stay visible. Freeze pauses the table, not devices.
暂无符合筛选条件的 OSC 参数（FT 默认隐藏，已映射参数始终显示）: No matching OSC parameters (FT hidden by default; mapped parameters always shown)
用此定位对象替换整套草稿，包括旧门控；保存前可恢复。: Replace the entire draft, including old gates, with this tracked object. Restore is available before saving.
添加映射草稿；请检查含义后保存。: Add a mapping draft; review its meaning before saving.
用选中预设的映射替换当前全部映射: Replace all current mappings with the selected preset

依次验证 START HERE 五档与 STOP、自己的 PB 抓取与两点校准、: Test START HERE's five levels and STOP, your own PB grab and two-point calibration, then native SPS at 08 MY AVATAR SPS.
保存配置会关闭输入。看 OSC 页“联动检查”，区分草稿未保存、接收未监听、门控: Saving settings disables input. The OSC workflow checks distinguish unsaved drafts, inactive receivers, closed gates and invalid tracking.
Shader 是单独的实验链路，不是 QuickStart / PB / 原生: Shader is a separate experiment, not a requirement for QuickStart, PB or native SPS.
先关闭输入，再添加输出设备并填写连接信息。输入若已开启且门控有效，连接后可能立即: Disable input before adding and configuring outputs. If input and gates are already active, connecting can send motion immediately.
在轴配置中限制允许行程、速度和方向，先用小范围验证。: Limit stroke, speed and direction in axis profiles; begin with a small range.
选择手动、OSC 或脚本输入，点击“应用输入方式”。切换页签只浏览界面。: Choose Manual, OSC or Script and click “Apply input mode”. Tabs alone only change the view.
确认映射与预览后，才打开输入开关。输入关闭、急停和断开各有独立状态。: Enable input only after checking mappings and previews. Input off, emergency stop and disconnection are distinct states.
停止输出后需要重新启用输入；解除急停不会自动恢复运动。: After stopping outputs, re-enable input manually. Clearing emergency stop does not resume motion automatically.
普通 SPS 用户先选择相应参数预设；FT 默认隐藏，可在参数工作台打开。: For ordinary SPS, choose the matching preset. FT is hidden by default; show it in the parameter workbench if needed.
需要定位时，在 Unity Avatar 根添加 Automatic SPS S: For tracking, add Automatic SPS Setup at the avatar root in Unity; choose Socket/Plug targets and capabilities.
每组默认只选择一个 Sensa 测量目标，初始 Off。Sensa 选择菜单独立: Each group selects one Sensa measurement target by default, initially Off. The Sensa selection menu is independent of SPS activation.
标准 Root 只有位置诊断；本地点/PB 是四接收器；配对三点姿态需要对方安装: Standard Root is diagnostic only. Local point/PB uses four receivers. Paired three-point pose requires matching markers on the other avatar.
在“空间诊断”检查有效性和采样。多来源时在参数工作台固定使用来源。: Check validity and samples in Spatial diagnostics. Pin the active source in the workbench when multiple sources exist.
Shader 曲线仍是实验路径；世界 Udon 测试不能代替头像上传或实际 PC: Shader curves remain experimental. World Udon tests do not replace avatar upload or real PCVR validation.
进入 OSC 的“量程校准”子页，选择本地点/PB 和 X/Y/Z/距原点。: Open OSC → Range calibration. Choose a local point/PB and X/Y/Z/distance.
把目标移到期望的 0% 位置并采集，再到 100% 位置采集。PB 采样时需保持: Move to the desired 0% endpoint and capture, then capture 100%. Keep the PB handle grabbed while sampling.
确认方向与百分比预览，生成草稿。小于 1 mm 的量程、无效采样或混合来源不会用: Check direction and the percentage preview before creating a draft. Ranges below 1 mm, invalid samples and mixed sources are rejected.
回到“参数与映射”，检查目标轴、输入范围和映射范围，点击保存并应用映射。: Return to Parameters and mappings. Check the target axis, input range and remap range, then Save and apply mappings.
草稿、预览和校准都不会自动启用输出。普通单侧 SPS 根部诊断不提供行程校准。: Drafts, previews and calibration never enable outputs automatically. Ordinary one-sided SPS root diagnostics do not support stroke calibration.
输入范围描述 OSC/局部测量；映射范围描述逻辑目标；每个输出的轴配置还会进一步: Input range describes OSC/local measurements; remap range describes logical targets. Each output's axis profile further constrains sent values.
每个输出卡显示自己的最近发送目标，而不是全局输入。TCode 为 0–999；I: Each output card shows its own last sent targets, not the global input. TCode uses 0–999; Intiface uses position/vibration percentages.
数值表示本地传输或 API 已接受的命令，不证明设备已经到位。UDP 没有远端确: Values mean the local transport/API accepted the command, not that hardware reached it. UDP has no remote acknowledgement. Intiface position direction may oppose L0.
没有数值：检查输出是否启用、连接、输入开关、门控和定位有效性。连接后尚未发送时保: No values? Check enabled/connected outputs, the input switch, gates and tracking validity. A connection without a sent command remains blank.
OSC 有值却不动：检查是否应用了 OSC 输入、是否保存映射、来源是否唯一、精: OSC values but no motion? Check applied OSC mode, saved mappings, unique source and valid precise tracking.
输入超时默认关闭；只有持续发送的来源才应设置断流停止，静止的增量 OSC 可能不: Input timeout is off by default. Only use it for continuously transmitting sources; change-only OSC can remain silent while stationary.
断开或停止后页面不会把旧目标冒充当前位置；日志用于查看发送异常。: Stopped or disconnected outputs do not present old targets as current positions. Inspect logs for sending errors.
普通 SPS 选择 Socket/Plug 角色，并区分仅他人、仅自身或两者。: For ordinary SPS, choose Socket/Plug and Others, Self or both.
本地点/PB 选择 Z、三轴或距原点；路径需限定唯一实例与来源，模板范围仍需校准: For local point/PB, choose Z, three axes or distance. Restrict the path to one instance/source and calibrate the template range.
Pose 需要配对标记；辅助信号优先选振动、门控、覆盖或方向单项。: Pose needs paired markers. For auxiliary signals, prefer dedicated vibration, gate, override or direction presets.
Root、SharedRoot 只做诊断；Shader 桥接有独立实验模板，合成: Root and SharedRoot are diagnostic only. Shader bridging has a separate experimental preset; synthetic codes are not SPS stroke. Importing a preset creates a draft without enabling outputs.
下载对应平台程序并解压运行。Windows 打开 Sensa.exe；浏览器进入: Download and extract the build for your platform. On Windows run Sensa.exe, then open localhost:5086.
在 Avatar 根添加 Sensa / Quick Start World R: Add Sensa / Quick Start World Receiver at the avatar root and re-upload. Requires Avatars SDK, Modular Avatar/NDMF and Sensa; no SPS or manual placement.
先不添加输出。开启 VRChat OSC 和 Sensa OSC 接收，应用 O: Start without outputs. Enable VRChat OSC and Sensa receiving, apply OSC mode, select “Start · Test world → My avatar”, replace other mappings and save.
进入测试世界 START HERE，点击阶梯或 TOUCH。核对 Depth 与: Enter START HERE in the test world and use the steps or TOUCH. Compare received Depth and Active with the world's expected values.
添加 TCode 串口输出，选择自己的端口。串口当前固定 115200；创建并绑: Add TCode Serial and select your port (currently 115200 baud). Create and assign “OSR first test · small L0 stroke”; check its limits against hardware calibration.
确认预览后再连接并打开输入。点击 STOP 应关闭门控；测试会在 60 秒或离开: After checking previews, connect and enable input. STOP should close the gate. The test ends after 60 seconds or when you leave the station.
入门组件用于测试链路。日常 SPS 使用原生 OGB 参数和对应预设；Autom: QuickStart tests the signal chain. Everyday SPS uses native OGB parameters and matching presets. Automatic SPS Setup's default Root is diagnostic only. World STOP does not power off or center hardware.
{0}{1} 是{2}阵列 {3} 的接近度输入样本，对应原始路径后缀 A{4}: {0}{1} is a proximity input sample from {2} array {3}, raw suffix A{4}. It matches the test scene's layout and color markers. It is not a TCode A0/A1/A2 output axis or a direct stroke signal.
定位阵列的一个距离样本，必须与同一对象的其余采样一起解算；不能直接当作深度。: One distance sample from a tracking array. Solve it together with the other samples for the same object; it is not depth by itself.
单侧 SPS 根部阵列的距离样本；8 路共同估计根部 XYZ，仅用于诊断。不能测: One-sided SPS root sample. Eight channels estimate root XYZ for diagnostics only, not tip, orientation or stroke. Do not map it directly to motion.
共享根部阵列；必须连同 Ready、Slot 与新槽位采样判定，仅用于诊断，不能: Shared root array: requires Ready, Slot and fresh slot samples. Diagnostic only; not a direct stroke signal.
本地骨骼/PB 测量。四路解算参考坐标系内的位置；PB 把手仅在抓取时有效。这不: Local bone/PB measurement. Four channels solve position in the reference frame; the PB handle is valid only while grabbed. This is not remote SPS or GPU mesh position.
根部表面到接收器的近接值。与同孔位 NewTip 配对估算长度；单值不能区分偏移: Proximity from the root surface to the receiver. Pair with NewTip at the same socket to estimate length; one value cannot distinguish offset from depth.
当前 VRCFury 中为根部同心长度球的近接值，并非真实尖端位置。饱和不等于准: Current VRCFury uses a root-centered length sphere, not the actual tip. Saturation is not accurate axial depth; Root/Tip pairing cannot resolve angle ambiguity.
近接信号：Others 表示他人，Self 表示自身。含义取决于生成器的接收器位: Proximity signal: Others means other players, Self means yourself. Meaning depends on receiver placement and radius, not a universal coordinate system.
近距离接触开关，不是连续行程值。: Near-contact switch, not a continuous stroke value.
身体触碰信号，通常用于振动强度；具体数值取决于 Contact 的设置。: Body touch signal, commonly used for vibration strength; values depend on Contact settings.
摩擦近接信号，通常用于振动；不是轴向深度。: Friction proximity signal, commonly used for vibration, not axial depth.
侧向接收器的原始近接值，不是角度（度）；受位移与方向共同影响。: Raw side-receiver proximity, not degrees; affected by both displacement and orientation.
自定义参数。请确认生成它的组件、量程和方向后再映射。名称相近仅作为查找提示。: Custom parameter. Confirm its source component, range and direction before mapping. Similar names are only search hints.

当前修改只是草稿。保存后才会生效，并会关闭输入；检查预览后再手动打开输入。: These changes are drafts. Saving applies them and disables input; check previews before enabling input manually.
当前运行的不是 OSC。切换到 OSC 页签后，还需点击“应用输入方式”。: OSC is not the active mode. Select the OSC tab, then click “Apply input mode”.
OSC 尚未监听。开启 OSC 接收并保存，检查端口是否被其他程序占用。: OSC is not listening. Enable receiving and save; check whether another application uses the port.
还没有已保存的映射。选择测试预设，点击“替换草稿”，再保存并应用。: No saved mappings. Choose a test preset, “Replace draft”, then save and apply.
急停尚未解除。解除后仍需手动打开输入。: Emergency stop is still active. After clearing it, enable input manually.
输入已关闭：保存配置也会关闭输入。先核对接收值，再打开输入观察运行目标。: Input is off; saving settings also disables it. Check received values, then enable input to inspect running targets.
已保存映射的门控未打开{0}。切换测试时用“替换草稿”，避免保留上一项门控。: A saved gate is closed{0}. Use “Replace draft” when changing tests to remove old gates.
定位当前无效。PB 须保持抓取；检查选中的测量目标、采样完整性和 OSC 来源。: Tracking is invalid. Keep PB grabbed; check the selected target, sample completeness and OSC source.
QuickStart 门控和其他测试映射混在一起：世界 STOP 后会同时挡住: QuickStart gates are mixed with other mappings: world STOP will also block PB / SPS. Replace the entire draft or remove unused gates explicitly.
联动检查 · 先看接收值，再看运行目标: Workflow checks · Received values first, then running targets
OSC 输入已开启，映射已保存。请继续对照实际接收值和运行目标；此状态不证明设备: OSC input is on and mappings are saved. Compare received values and running targets; this does not prove hardware reached the target.
测试 Avatar、世界和 Sensa 的完整联动步骤: Full avatar, world and Sensa workflow
尚无可显示的发送目标。连接不会自动移动设备。: No sent targets yet. Connecting alone does not move devices.
显示该输出最近发送的目标值，已包含输出侧映射；不是设备位置传感器回读。: Last sent targets for this output, after output mapping; these are not position sensor readings.

侧视 Z / X · 向右为入孔: Side Z / X · right points inward

配套标记相对 Socket 的位置与姿态: Marker position and orientation relative to the Socket
PenOthers 是生成器定义的接近信号，不是 XYZ 坐标；球面等距离会把横: PenOthers is generator-defined proximity, not XYZ. Equal spherical distances mix lateral offset and depth. Current VRCFury NewTip measures a root-centered length sphere, not the actual tip; Root/Tip still cannot resolve offset or orientation. For one-sided installation, use SPS root diagnostics below. The precise scheme needs matching components on both avatars: place Spatial Pose Socket / Plug prefabs in Unity, use the same channel, align Root/Tip/Side to actual bones and point Socket +Z inward. 24 samples locate three markers. Only one matching target and uniform scale are supported. Fit residual is not measured accuracy and cannot exclude every multi-target mix.

普通 OGB 参数会继续显示在下方。安装配套预制件后，这里会显示深度、横向偏移、: Ordinary OGB parameters remain below. Install matching prefabs to see depth, lateral offset, tilt and twist here.
八点阵列显示为 C1–C8，四点本地/PB 阵列显示为 P1–P4；原始字段均从: Eight-point arrays display C1–C8; four-point local/PB arrays display P1–P4. Raw fields start at A0 for both, but layouts differ. These are input samples, not auxiliary output axes. The workbench shows colors and paths.
替换整套草稿并移除旧门控；六轴仍需校准。保存前可在映射页恢复原配置。: Replaces the entire draft and removes old gates. Six-axis mapping still needs calibration. Restore the saved configuration before saving if needed.
cm · 残差只表示拟合一致性，不是实际误差。: cm · Residual measures fit consistency, not actual error.
观测对象是标记/骨骼，不是 GPU 形变后的网格。尺寸为 Socket 局部单位: Observations track markers/bones, not GPU-deformed meshes. Dimensions use Socket local units. Output stops outside the virtual opening, at excessive angles or with invalid tracking; no automatic OGB fallback. Last parameter change:
；静止值不代表断线。: ; a stationary value does not mean disconnected.

局部坐标投影 ±25 cm · 并非有效采样区域边界: Local projection ±25 cm · not the sampling validity boundary
读取自己的骨骼或 PB 把手位置；不是对方的完整姿态，也不是 GPU 形变网格。: Reads your own bone or PB handle position, not the other avatar's full pose or GPU mesh. PB handles are active only while grabbed.
自己安装根部探针，对方保留标准 TPS_Pen_Root 即可。共享阵列一次只测: Install root probes on your side; the other avatar only needs standard TPS_Pen_Root. Shared arrays measure one slot at a time and cannot reconstruct tip, tilt, twist or insertion ratio.
所选目标已不在当前来源中。重新选择目标后再校准，旧采样不会自动用于其他目标。: The selected target is no longer in the current source. Select again and recalibrate; old samples are not transferred to another target.
等待阵列采样（标准八路，本地点四路）。Unity 中添加 Automatic S: Waiting for array samples (eight standard, four local). Add Automatic SPS Setup or Local Bone or PB Probe in Unity. Observation and calibration work with input off.
。检查目标是否在范围内、采样是否完整；PB 还需保持抓取。: . Check target range and complete samples; keep PB grabbed.
请选择 Point 或 Handle 本地点进行量程校准。标准 SPS Root: Select a local Point or Handle for range calibration. Standard SPS Root and shared roots provide diagnostic positions only, not full stroke.
将目标移到期望的 0% 和 100% 位置，分别采集。PB 把手须保持抓取；结果: Move to the desired 0% and 100% positions and capture each. Keep PB grabbed. The result replaces the entire draft and removes old gates; restore the original configuration before saving if needed.
当前位置超出校准量程，预览已限制到 0–100%。: Position is outside the calibrated range; preview is clamped to 0–100%.
量程随坐标减小而增大，已自动反向。: The range increases as coordinates decrease; inversion applied automatically.
量程随坐标增大而增大。: The range increases as coordinates increase.
数值为探针局部坐标。残差不等于实际误差；多个同标签目标可能混入。: Values use probe-local coordinates. Residual is not actual error; multiple targets with the same tag may mix.
位移映射需校准，多个目标匹配或失去有效采样时停止输入。: Calibrate displacement mappings. Multiple matching targets or invalid samples stop input.
SPS 根部和共享阵列只提供诊断，不生成运动映射。: SPS roots and shared arrays provide diagnostics only; they do not create motion mappings.
配合 Avatar 的 Quick Start World Receiver 和: Use with Quick Start World Receiver on your avatar and START HERE in the world. No SPS, camera or Python needed. Steps expect 0/25/50/75/100%; Active is the gate, Stop closes it. Tests the chain, not SPS depth.
配套三标记 / 24 接收器。使用轴线与孔口平面的交点求插入比例。丢失或无效时停: Three paired markers / 24 receivers. Computes insertion ratio from the axis intersection with the opening plane. Invalid or missing tracking stops output without OGB fallback.
同一对象的深度、偏航、俯仰、扭转与孔口 X/Y 偏移。X/Y 映射到 L2/L1: Depth, yaw, pitch, twist and opening X/Y offset from the same object. X/Y map to L2/L1. Check axis orientation and inversion against hardware.
四接收器本地测量，单位为参考局部米。范围仅为模板，请在量程校准中采集，限定一个实: Four-receiver local measurement in reference-local meters. Template ranges need calibration. Select one instance and source; all three axes must use that instance. Does not measure remote bones or shader deformation.
